subject: Re: ABC factor isolation kickoff
body: Integration recommendation, as promised by end of June: adopt, narrowly. The pose-estimation results are the deciding evidence — in the dictionary-lookup scenario the ABC representations retrieve correct poses at parity with the supervised baseline, and the regression scenario lands within 8% of it with zero pose labels, which is the cost story the editing-pipeline team cares about. Recommendation shipped to their leads today: use ABC-style set supervision for the pose/identity split in the editing pipeline; hold off on style/content until we run their production data distribution (a Q3 item, written into OKRs pre-lock). Loose ends: Carmen's bias-corrected MINE variant fixed the estimator variance and goes into the repo docs; Oyin's Corpus mirror of Shapes3D becomes the canonical copy. Thanks all — tight window, no drama. — Lucia
